=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text first "first 15 terms:"
text dup "first term already seen: a("
text eqs ") = "
text cov "terms a(0)..a(n) first contain every integer 0..1000 at n = "
note sn v is 1 once v has appeared; the oracle's run shows no term before 0..1000 is covered exceeds 1942300
global sn uchar 1942301
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note a(0) = 0; a(n) = a(n-1) - n if that is positive and new, else a(n-1) + n
note bound: the cover is complete at n = 328002, below the 999999 loop bound
fn main to int
emit first
emit sp
emitu 0
put sn 0 1
a = ulong 0
n = ulong 0
d = ulong 0
c = ulong 1
while lt c 1001 bound 999999
n = add n 1
nw = add a n
if gt a n
if eq get sn sub a n 0
nw = sub a n
end
end
a = nw
if eq get sn a 0
if le a 1000
c = add c 1
end
else
if eq d 0
d = n
emit nl
emit dup
emitu n
emit eqs
emitu a
emit nl
end
end
put sn a 1
if lt n 15
emit sp
emitu a
end
end
emit cov
emitu n
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
first 15 terms: 0 1 3 6 2 7 13 20 12 21 11 22 10 23 9
first term already seen: a(24) = 42
terms a(0)..a(n) first contain every integer 0..1000 at n = 328002
</pre>
